# body-layout

One sheet, two deployed files — the ordinary shape for a product whose
configuration is split across more than one file, and the only spec in this
repository that groups by file.

It exists because nothing else here has that shape, and the file axis is where
the next structural work happens: what a reader sees when a sheet is several
files, and where the headings they navigate by come from.

Built by the CLI in whatever reads it, never hand-written into a model. A
hand-written model is a reconstructed input wearing a test's clothes: it says
whatever its author believed the assembler produces.
